gold_answer: the Court may direct that any person under the age of sixteen years or any woman or any sick or infirm person accused of such an offence be released on bail
evidence_full_text: Provided that the Court may direct that any person under the age of sixteen years or any woman or any sick or infirm person accused of such an offence be released on bail.

author: Jaeef
question_bn: ফৌজদারী কার্যবিধি, ১৮৯৮-এর ৪৯৭ ধারা অনুযায়ী, জামিনে ছেড়ে দেওয়ার সময় কর্মকর্তা বা আদালতকে কী করতে হবে?
question_banglish: Foujadari Karyabidhi 1898 er 497 dhara anujayi, jamine chhede dewar shomoy kormokorta ba adalatke ki korte hobe?
gold_answer: shall record in writing his or its reasons for so doing
evidence_full_text: (3) An officer or a Court releasing any person on bail under sub-section (1) or sub-section (2) shall record in writing his or its reasons for so doing.
